limits: 起降为干燥水平硬跑道、无风、规定工程襟翼/摩擦及作用盘损失模型；未经具体全尺寸桨、襟翼和试飞标定。
场地温度/高度仅用于起降；任务仍采用规定巡航高度的标准大气。起降段耗油仍沿用30s/90%功率，距离校核与瞬态燃油尚未联算。
CG研究区间来自用户假设，不是允许装载包线；额外装载分配须另核座椅/行李舱限重。
纵向一级模型采用有限翼升力斜率和线性下洗；未包括机身、滑流、推力线及黏性俯仰矩修正。给定Cm扰动是情景范围，不是统计置信区间。
AVL/XFOIL和一级模型的俯仰力矩均有误差；力矩平衡、低角度余量与局部静稳定分别报告，完整操稳/操纵力仍未计算。
速度为低CL域内9个候选的初步最小需用功率选择；增强模型沿用并验证实际工况，不宣称原生气动全域最优。

speed_selection.method: finite candidate minimum conceptual shaft power

speed_candidates.basis: same geometry/mass/CG/rated power; requested ROC=3m/s; finite candidates, no mission replacement or map extrapolation

noncontrolling_constraint_baseline.basis: Same input except name/confirmation/new first-level profile; expected unchanged controlling area/power and native schedule. This is numerical/model regression, not aircraft validation.

limits: No target-aircraft fit. Unfitted public data are partial-condition checks, not complete aircraft validation.
Low-speed disk/friction/flap and linear-tail models are declared concept assumptions; pitch-moment sensitivity is not a confidence interval.
Actual representative CG and perturbed elevator limits remain exceeded; numerical convergence does not establish feasibility.
Native finite candidates do not change the recorded mission or constitute a global optimum. Full stability envelope and structural mass feedback remain future nodes.

numerical_recovery.correction: One final zero-CL initialization at original panels, 200 iterations / 60 seconds; unchanged physical inputs and convergence criteria.
